description: Angular component for displaying, creating, editing, and deleting journal entries. Handles user interactions and communicates with JournalEntryService for data operations.

classes.name: JournalListComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing the journal entries list, including CRUD interactions and UI state handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that initializes the component by calling refresh to load entries.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of journal entries from the service, updates the entries array, handles loading state and errors.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Prepares the component to create a new journal entry by resetting editId and showing the editor.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Prepares the component to edit an existing journal entry by setting the editId and showing the editor.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a journal entry through the service, then refreshes the list.

methods.name: onSaved
methods.description: Hides the editor and reloads the journal entries after a save operation.

methods.name: onCancelled
methods.description: Hides the editor without saving changes.

ctags.name: confirmed
ctags.pattern: /^    const confirmed = window.confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this entry?');$/
